title: Null control: Tokyo precip vs FRO returns
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Null control: Tokyo daily precipitation 20d z-score > 1 has no relation to tanker equity returns at 0-5 day lags (0); no trade [weather.tokyo.precip -> finance.FRO.log_return] (parent: R2-0020)

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.tokyo.precip rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long FRO next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Second null control: Tokyo max wind 20d z-score > 1 has no relation to FRO log returns at 0-5 day lags (0); a spurious in-sample edge like the precip run would show the backtester rewards noise; no trade [weather.tokyo.wind_max -> finance.FRO.log_return] (parent: R2-0118)
